notes:
• First release.
• Menu bar item showing the next assignment and a live countdown, colour-coded by urgency, updating once a minute.
• Panel listing the next ten assignments with one-click open in Canvas.
• Settings window: feeds, refresh interval, look-ahead window, notifications with 24 h / 3 h / 1 h lead times, past-due grace period, open at login.
• Hand-written RFC 5545 parser with no dependencies; handles Canvas and Google Calendar feeds, byte-level line unfolding, time zones and all-day due dates.
• Offline support: the last successful fetch is cached and shown with its age.
